description: Explainable AI (11) input. There is no standalone explainability service, route or table: an explanation in SentinelAI is the provenance chain carried on the records themselves. This file declares the chain that must be walkable after the full SOC scenario runs. Every id is a placeholder substituted at run time with the identity the real pipeline actually minted - no evidence id is fabricated here.

chain.note: FileLogCollector assigns the event id and preserves the raw record verbatim in raw_data.
Same event_id is carried through; normalization never changes provenance.
DetectionEvidence.matched_fields / matched_conditions name the exact normalized fields and Sigma conditions that matched.
CorrelationResult.evidence names the signal (shared_event_id) and the member count.
The three factors (member_volume, event_breadth, detection_diversity) each carry per-item RiskEvidence naming the member/detection they came from.
Evidence ids are UUIDv5 values derived from the context namespace, so the same context always yields the same ids.
A finding may only cite evidence ids that exist in the context. A dangling or invented id rejects the entire model output.

invariants: Provenance is pinned per layer and cannot be reused by another layer.
A finding's confidence is the model's own; it is never derived from the risk score or detection severity.
Recalled incident memory is history, never current observed evidence.
